Based on the significant proteinuria, elevated creatinine, hypoalbuminemia, and unexplained weight loss in a 66-year-old male, this clinical picture strongly suggests nephrotic syndrome, likely due to an underlying malignancy or chronic inflammatory state. The recent fatigue and leg swelling are classic signs of hypoalbuminemia and fluid overload.
